arguments.explanation: Without a reference, center = apparent_displacement_m = -4.231944863704031e-08 m, sigma = 1e-09 m, B = 8e-09 m. The 95% Gaussian confidence set enlarged by the absolute nuisance bound is h = 1.959963984540054*sigma + B = 1.959963984540054e-09 + 8e-09 = 9.959963984540054e-09 m. The interval is [center - h, center + h] = [-1.419140862154439e-08, 5.728019020836023e-09]. Let T = -resolution_m = -1e-08 m. Since upper (5.728e-09) <= T (-1e-08) is false and lower (-1.419e-08) > T (-1e-08) is true, the entire interval lies below T, ruling out inward motion beyond the resolution. Thus compression is supported.
arguments.next_step: Report compression_supported with interval [-1.42e-08, 5.73e-09] m and proceed to next measurement.
